title: Advancement Counter
description: Count how many advancement's you've completed and how many in total are in the game.
body:
Have you ever wondered how many advancedments were truly in your game? Or how many you've completed? Well, this mod adds a counter which allows you to track how many advancedments you've completed, and how many you have left to do. It's compatible with datapacks and mods that add advancements. 

What does this mod do?
This mod adds a counter system and a new advancement. The counter allows you to see how many advancements are in your game, and how many you have completed so far. Once you've completed every advancement in the game, you get an advancement!
